findings.title: Conversion Rate - Analysis Period
findings.claim: During the analysis period (Mar 30 - Apr 6, 2026), the cafe achieved a conversion rate of 25.26%, with 1411 valid transactions from 5585 footfall entries.
coverage_notes: Excluded 0 dead sensor days from denominator
assumptions: Transaction ID uniqueness represents distinct customer baskets
Refunds excluded from valid transaction count
Dead sensor days excluded from footfall denominator

findings.title: Labour Cost to Sales Ratio
findings.claim: During the analysis period, total labour costs were 6272.00 SAR against 47758.95 SAR in net sales, yielding a labour-to-sales ratio of 13.13%.
coverage_notes: Staff records: 37 entries for analysis period
POS records: 2411 line items for analysis period
assumptions: Labour cost includes all computed duration-based costs
No imputation for missing cashier linkage

findings.title: Known Waste Analysis
findings.claim: During the analysis period, 2749 units were wasted with a known cost of 16552.90 SAR. The waste-to-total-units ratio was 18.88%, indicating 18.9% of inventory was wasted.
coverage_notes: Unknown waste values excluded per requirements
Analysis covers 6 items with recorded waste
assumptions: Inventory week_starting dates align with analysis period
Known waste cost is accurate and complete
Unknown waste values are not imputed
